messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for The Cressex Club?
messages.body:
Hi,

Just checking you saw my earlier note about Jake Essex for The Cressex Club. High-energy classics, not an impersonator, fully self-contained with his own PA.

Clubs usually look at from £250 for two one hour sets, no deposit. If you've got a Friday or Saturday free further out, I'd love to pencil a date.

If it's not for you, reply "no thanks" and I won't email again.

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
www.jakeessex.co.uk

messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for The Milestone Bar & Social Club?
messages.body:
Hi,

Following up on Jake Essex for The Milestone Bar & Social Club. He sings the 50s and 60s properly (Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra, Elvis and more), own PA, no deposit.

From £250 for two one hour sets. If entertainment is committee-led, that figure is usually enough to take to a meeting. Saturdays and Sundays suit him best.

If it's a no, just say so and I'll leave you alone.

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
www.jakeessex.co.uk
